centrallanglinks-desc: Centralised interlanguage links: one shared table maps each concept (keyed by its English page title) to the page title in every language.
translations-summary: Add, edit or remove the central interlanguage translations for a concept. The English page title is the concept key; changes take effect immediately on every language's sidebar.
centrallanglinks-lookup-label: Concept (English title) or any page title:
centrallanglinks-browse: $1 concepts in the table. Enter a concept above, or pick one below:
centrallanglinks-new: No entry yet for "$1". Fill in the translations below to create it.
centrallanglinks-links-help: Example: de:Dresden. Include one line per language, using each language's own page title. The English line is the concept key.
centrallanglinks-error-badline: Could not parse "$1" — expected the form lang:Title.
centrallanglinks-error-badlang: "$1" is not a known language code in this wiki family.
centrallanglinks-error-duplang: Language "$1" is listed more than once.
centrallanglinks-error-badtitle: "$1" is not a valid page title.
log-description-translations: Changes to the central interlanguage translation table.
